summary: CNB Financial Corporation filed an 8-K declaring a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.19 per common share, payable June 15, 2026 to holders of record June 1, 2026. The board declared the dividend and a press release was attached as Exhibit 99.1. This is a routine capital return event, not a special situation. The filing does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special-situations category. The company is a financial holding company with $8.5 billion in assets, primarily operating through CNB Bank.
